results.name: Plate Clean
instructions: Stand with a weight plate on the floor in front of you and grip it by its sides.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward explosively and pull the plate up.
Catch it at your chest with your elbows under it, then lower and repeat.
tips: The power comes from your hips, not your arms.
Keep the plate close to your body.
results.description: Plate Clean is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Plate Thruster
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up explosively and press the plate overhead in one movement.
Lower the plate to your chest as you go into the next squat.
tips: Use the momentum from your legs to help the press.
Keep your heels down in the squat.
results.description: Plate Thruster is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Triceps, Core.

results.name: Sandbag Cleans
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and grab the sandbag by its sides or handles.
Drive your hips forward explosively and pull the bag up to your chest.
Catch it close to your body, lower it and repeat.
tips: Keep your back flat at the start.
Pull the bag up close to your body.
results.description: Sandbag Cleans is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps, Biceps, Core.

results.name: Across Chest Shoulder Stretch (Front View)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back straight. Raise one arm to shoulder height and bring it across your chest.
Use your opposite hand to grasp your upper arm and gently pull it towards your chest, stretching your shoulder.
Hold the stretch in this position.
Release your arm and repeat the movement on the other side.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching them up towards your ears.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to help relax your muscles.
Maintain a straight back and avoid twisting your torso to ensure proper form.
results.description: Across Chest Shoulder Stretch (Front View) is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Arm Circle (Single Rep)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight to your sides.
Begin by making circular motions with your arms, moving them forward in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and balance throughout the exercise.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Keep your arms straight and focus on making smooth, controlled circles to ensure proper form.
results.description: Arm Circle (Single Rep) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Arm Swing Side to Side
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Swing your arms forward until they meet and cross together in front of you in a hugging motion.
Swing your arms back to the starting position.
Continue swinging your arms forward and back in a controlled, rhythmic manner.
tips: Keep your arms at shoulder level to ensure proper form and muscle activation.
Engage your core to maintain stability and control throughout the movement.
Focus on smooth, controlled movements to maximize the effectiveness of the exercise and avoid injury.
results.description: Arm Swing Side to Side is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Arms Behind Back Shoulder Flexor Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides.
Bring both arms behind your back. Set your forearms parallel to the floor, crossing one over the other to stretch your shoulders.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your shoulders. Return to the starting position and repeat as needed.
tips: Maintain an upright posture without arching your lower back excessively.
Breathe slowly and deeply throughout the stretch, keeping your chest up and focusing on your shoulders.
Stretch only until you feel gentle tension, not pain.
Keep your neck relaxed and your head in a neutral position.
results.description: Arms Behind Back Shoulder Flexor Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Arnold Press Cable Resistance Band Standing
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight, feet shoulder-width apart, in the middle of a resistance band.
Hold the band handles with your arms bent close to your chest and palms facing back.
Push the handles up, while rotating your arms and hands to look forward, and extending your arms overhead.
Return to the initial position by reversing the movement and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the band overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
Use a resistance band with appropriate tension to ensure you can perform the exercise with good form.
Maintain a neutral wrist position to reduce strain on your joints.
results.description: Arnold Press Cable Resistance Band Standing is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.
